notes: The identity of BetterClipboard's Microsoft Store package (docs/microsoft-store.md, 'The owner's steps').
Partner Center assigns these values when the app's name is reserved: Product identity > Package/Identity/Name,
Package/Identity/Publisher and Package/Properties/PublisherDisplayName. Copy them here exactly and set
'reserved' to true; tools/release/package-msix.ps1 refuses to build a package for the Store until then.
'displayName' is the reserved app name (the Store refuses a package whose display name is not reserved).
The values below are placeholders that only work for test packages (package-msix.ps1 -TestCertificate),
where the publisher is replaced by the test certificate's subject anyway. Nothing here is a secret.
name: BetterClipboard.Unreserved
